اسلنطعت (form IIIq)
# اِسْلَنْطَعْتُ (islanṭaʕtu) /is.lan.tˤaʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
# اِسْلَنْطَعْتَ (islanṭaʕta) /is.lan.tˤaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
# اِسْلَنْطَعْتِ (islanṭaʕti) /is.lan.tˤaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
# اِسْلَنْطَعَتْ (islanṭaʕat)
